fields.title: Receptionist/Front Office Assistant
fields.description: Our client, a leading company in the branding sector, is seeking to recruit a Receptionist/Front Office Assistant. The ideal candidate will be the first point of contact for visitors and clients, ensuring a welcoming and professional experience. This role requires excellent communication skills, strong organizational abilities, and the ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.
fields.requirements:
• Greet and welcome visitors in a friendly and professional manner.
• Answer and direct phone calls, emails, and inquiries to the appropriate departments.
• Manage front office operations, including handling correspondence and scheduling appointments.
• Maintain a clean and organized reception area.
• Assist with administrative tasks such as data entry, filing, and preparing reports.
• Coordinate meetings, book conference rooms, and ensure meeting areas are set up appropriately.
• Manage office supplies inventory and place orders as needed.
• Receive and distribute mail, packages, and deliveries efficiently.
• Support the sales and customer service teams by providing necessary information to clients.
• Maintain records of visitors and ensure adherence to security and safety protocols.
